summary.text: Paula Calhoon is a Republican state representative from Lexington County who has represented South Carolina House District 87 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner and former teacher, Calhoon serves on the Ethics and Judiciary committees.

paragraphs.text: Calhoon earned a B.A. from the University of South Carolina in 1980 and an M.S. in 1981.
She taught in Lexington District One from 1981 to 1989 and worked as a research assistant for S.C. Senate Research in 1991.
She was deputy director of the S.C. Commission on Prosecution Coordination from 1991 to 2011.
Calhoon took office on November 12, 2018, succeeding Todd Atwater.
The Republican primary on June 9, 2026, was canceled, and Calhoon faces Democrat Reid Beaman in the November 3 general election.
